# Requirements Document: Bookstore Application

## Project Overview
A web-based bookstore application that allows users to browse, search, and purchase books online.

## User Stories

### P0 — Must Have
1. **As a customer**, I want to browse books by category, so that I can discover books in genres I enjoy.
   - **Acceptance Criteria:**
     - Given I am on the browse page, When I select a category, Then I see only books in that category.
     - Given no books exist in a category, When I select it, Then I see an empty state message.

2. **As a customer**, I want to search for books by title or author, so that I can find specific books quickly.
   - **Acceptance Criteria:**
     - Given I enter a search query, When I submit, Then I see matching results within 500ms.
     - Given no results match, When I search, Then I see a 'No results found' message.

3. **As a customer**, I want to add books to a shopping cart, so that I can purchase multiple books at once.
   - **Acceptance Criteria:**
     - Given I am viewing a book, When I click 'Add to Cart', Then the cart count increments.
     - Given I have items in cart, When I view cart, Then I see all items with prices and total.

4. **As a customer**, I want to complete a checkout with payment, so that I can purchase my selected books.
   - **Acceptance Criteria:**
     - Given I have items in cart, When I proceed to checkout, Then I see a payment form.
     - Given payment succeeds, When I submit, Then I see an order confirmation with order ID.

5. **As an admin**, I want to manage book inventory (CRUD), so that I can keep the catalog current.
   - **Acceptance Criteria:**
     - Given I am an admin, When I access the admin panel, Then I can create, read, update, and delete books.

### P1 — Should Have
6. **As a customer**, I want to see book reviews and ratings, so that I can make informed purchases.
7. **As a customer**, I want to view my order history, so that I can track past purchases.

### P2 — Nice to Have
8. **As a customer**, I want book recommendations based on my browsing history.

## Non-Functional Requirements
- **Performance:** Page load under 2 seconds, search results under 500ms.
- **Security:** All API endpoints authenticated, passwords hashed with bcrypt, HTTPS only.
- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
- **Scalability:** Support 1000 concurrent users.

## Scope Boundaries
- **In Scope:** Book CRUD, search, cart, checkout, user auth, admin panel.
- **Out of Scope:** Physical shipping logistics, real payment processing (use Stripe test mode), mobile native apps.

## Assumptions
- PostgreSQL for the database.
- FastAPI for the backend.
- Next.js for the frontend.
